summary.text: Tiffany Spann-Wilder is a Democratic attorney and judge who has represented District 109 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since April 2, 2024, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tiffany Spann-Wilder was born in Charleston, South Carolina.

Spann-Wilder earned a bachelor's degree from Winthrop University in 1995 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1998, and she served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1997 to 2006.

Her professional experience includes work as an attorney and a judge, and she has been affiliated with the SC Bar Association, the American Bar Association, the National Bar Association, Jack and Jill of America, Inc., The Links, Inc., and Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc.
Spann-Wilder succeeded Deon Tedder as the District 109 representative.
